scope.description: Exercise the read-index retry-growth trigger on a real three-node network by isolating the leader from both followers and then submitting same-context ReadIndex requests, recording the admitted request count and the heartbeat messages emitted.
assumptions: Real three-node raft network built with the package test helpers; leader 1 elected by MsgHup, so the log commits and committedEntryInCurrentTerm is true before the partition, which puts requests on the admitted rather than the queued path.

The partition is expressed with the network helper's isolate for peers 2 and 3, and outbound messages are counted and cleared each round so the count reflects heartbeats produced rather than a growing buffer.
CheckQuorum is left at the library default of false, so the leader is not required to step down within an election timeout; ReadOnlySafe is the default option.
excluded: Any claim about a real transport or about message loss beyond the modelled isolation.
The queued path, which other receipts cover by leaving the leader short of a term-commit.

basis.prefix: TestAssuranceReadIndexIsolatedNetwork builds newNetwork(nil, nil, nil), elects leader 1 with a MsgHup, and emits a setup event with state, id, committed index, committedEntryInCurrentTerm, CheckQuorum, the read-only option and voter count. It then isolates peers 2 and 3, clears the outbound buffers, and submits 32 local MsgReadIndex messages carrying the same RequestCtx; after each step it counts MsgHeartbeat messages in the leader's outbound buffer and clears both buffers. Finally it emits the round count, unconfirmedReads length, heartbeat count, pending queue length, confirmedReads and the node state.

comparisons.description: With the leader partitioned from both followers, all 32 same-context requests are admitted and none is confirmed.
Each admitted request emits one heartbeat per peer, so 32 requests in a three-voter cluster produce 64 heartbeat messages.

knowledge.assertion: admission is per request and context-blind, and each admitted request broadcasts a heartbeat
retained payload equals accepted requests times caller-chosen context size, held in distinct buffers
